questions.explanation: The useful first step is to state the view in its strongest form. Care ethics emphasizes relationships, empathy, and responsibilities of care. This is the position defended by Carol Gilligan. The claim that care ethics emphasizes abstract impartial rules above all is a common mistake about the view, often described as "conflates care with impartialism". A fair assessment also has to reckon with this worry: it may neglect impartial justice. A careful reader separates the actual doctrine from the frequent misreading.
questions.hint: Put yourself in the position of someone defending ethics of care.
